title: feat(slash): floating menu UI with ranking, result cap, and toolbar slash commands

reviews.body:
Review completed. Overall this is a solid and well-scoped implementation for the slash menu capability.

What I checked:

- Reviewed the core slash state/ranking path (`getSlashMatch`, `filterSlashCommands`, `computeSlashState`) and the `EditorConfig.slashMenuLimit` integration in `editor.ts`.
- Reviewed the vanilla DOM floating menu implementation, including lifecycle, keyboard handling, IME guard, outside-click dismissal, viewport positioning, ARIA attributes, and `destroy()` cleanup symmetry.
- Reviewed toolbar slash command registration and confirmed the commands reuse the existing formatting helpers.
- Reviewed demo integration and package exports/docs/spec updates.
- Ran the focused PR test set: 5 files / 84 tests passed.
- Ran the full test suite: 28 files / 268 tests passed.
- Ran the full build successfully.

Notes:

- The headless/event-first design is preserved: the UI remains optional, and hosts can still consume `slashMenuChange` directly.
- Keeping empty-query order as registration order is the right default for host-curated/frequently-used command ordering.
- The UI implementation avoids innerHTML for command text, which keeps command-provided title/description safe.
- `destroy()` correctly removes editor subscriptions and document/window listeners.

No blocking issues found from this review. Nice work on the tests and OpenSpec coverage as well.
